data.narrative:
Axibo AI is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing automation company that has raised C$12M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a sector universe of nine private peers (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI) and one public comparable.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable approach, using the C$12M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage transitions in venture markets. This yields an implied valuation of $30M. A peer-median approach was not viable due to insufficient granular comparables—while 11 same-sector peers exist in the robotics and manufacturing space, fewer than three qualify as narrow-stage or valuation-tier matches, making a median calculation unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $26M to $34M, centered at $30M. This range reflects the single triangulation method's result and reasonable variance around stage-typical step-ups. Key uncertainties include the absence of tightly matched peers at the Seed stage in this sector, which limits cross-validation; the applicability of a 2.5x multiplier to Axibo's specific market position and cap table; and whether C$12M raised materially differs from post-money valuation at the most recent financing event. Further clarification on round structure and timing would refine the range.
